description: Switch each automatic PSIF IMS email on or off.

fields.label: Training Matrix
fields.description: Untick an email to stop it going out. Records, statuses and ToDos carry on as normal; only the email is skipped. Recipients and timing are set in Training Matrix Settings.

fields.label: Overdue Escalation Email
fields.description: To the escalation recipients when a course is still overdue after Escalate After days. When off, the escalation ToDo is still assigned and the course is marked escalated, so it is not emailed later.

fields.label: Training Acknowledgment Request
fields.description: To attendees when a Training Record is submitted. When off, the training still waits for their acknowledgment in My Training.

fields.label: Retraining Required
fields.description: To the employees on a submitted Retraining Assignment.

fields.label: Monthly Training Status Report
fields.description: First Monday of the month: each manager's team report and the company-wide report.

fields.label: Training Request Decision
fields.description: To the employee when their manager approves or rejects a Training Request.

fields.label: Overdue Certificate Reminder
fields.description: To the employee and manager when an external training certificate is late. When off, no reminder is recorded, so turning it back on reminds once for each certificate still late.

fields.label: ToDo Assignment Emails
fields.description: The bell notification and email when PSIF IMS assigns someone a ToDo (overdue training, training requests, skills ready for authorization, failed evaluations, housekeeping findings). When off, the ToDo is still assigned. Assignments made by hand in the desk are not affected; each person's Notification Settings still apply when on.

fields.label: HSE Snapshot
fields.options: The weekly and monthly HSE Snapshot emails are switched on, scheduled and addressed in HSE Snapshot Settings.

name: PSIF IMS Email Settings
